title: Mid-Sentence
summary: Group scene, and the origin of the week's promise. The Saturday trip was always in this scene's fiction -- June is negotiating a lift out of Mara when the player walks in -- and Milestone 3 nevertheless wrote a second scene, june_needs_saturday, in which June asks for the same Saturday all over again. That scene is cut and its commitment lives here, where it costs the player something: two of the three branches get them included, and the third gets the whole thing explained to them and leaves them out of it.
